title: Delete is disabled while a part still uses the Part Library entry
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test at the test location only, on no work order and with no open return or credit, so it can be deleted later in the test.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Click the pencil icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  4. Hover over the Delete button at the bottom left of the window.
  5. Click the Delete button.
  6. Click Cancel.
  7. Click Parts in the top bar.
  8. Click Inventory in the left menu.
  9. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  10. Click the part A row.
  11. Click Delete Part.
  12. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  13. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  14. Click the part A row.
  15. Click the pencil icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  16. Hover over the Delete button.
  17. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A's entry is listed.

Step 2:

  • The entry's detail page opens and shows "Total parts" 1.

Step 3:

  • The "Edit Library Part" window opens.
  • A Delete button sits at the bottom left of the window, dimmed (disabled).

Step 4:

  • Hovering it shows "Part cannot be deleted. Please delete related parts first."

Step 5:

  • Nothing happens: no "Are you sure you want to delete this library part?" question opens and the window stays open.

Step 6:

  • The window closes and the entry is still there.

Step 7:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 8:

  • The Inventory page opens.

Step 9:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 10:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A.

Step 11:

  • The window closes and part A leaves the Inventory list: it is deleted.

Step 12:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 13:

  • Part A's entry is still listed, although its part was deleted.

Step 14:

  • The detail page shows "Total parts" 0: no part uses the entry any more.

Step 15:

  • The "Edit Library Part" window opens and its Delete button is now enabled.

Step 16:

  • No hover text appears on the enabled Delete button.

Step 17:

  • The window closes.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 35 (edited 27 Oct 2026 by Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only), story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library)

  • S11-R3c: “While an inventory part, an open part request or a part return still uses the entry, the Delete button is disabled and hovering it shows "Part cannot be deleted. Please delete related parts first."”
  • S11-R3: “Clicking a row opens that entry's detail page. The pencil beside the entry's name opens the "Edit Library Part" window, where the entry is edited and where its Delete button sits, bottom left. The detail page itself has no Delete button.”
  • S12-R13: “Deleting a Part Library entry asks "Are you sure you want to delete this library part?"”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Delete on a Part Library entry a part still uses | "Part cannot be deleted. Please delete related parts first." | Hover text on the disabled Delete button (S11-R3c)”

From: Product's answers (Chris Ward, 9 Oct and 14 Oct 2026, saved in po-answers-2026-10-09/ and po-answers-2026-10-14/), read 27 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward, 14 Oct 2026, answer 12: “Board 7.2 is right: the page has no Delete button. Delete sits bottom left in the "Edit Library Part" window, opened by the pencil beside the entry's name (S11-R3). While a part uses the entry, Delete is disabled with the hover text "Part cannot be deleted. Please delete related parts first." (S11-R3c).”
  • QA lead, 9 Oct 2026, set-up answer 4: “Yes after deleting the inventory part from parts -> Inventory you can still locate its catalogue entry from parts catalog”

From: Product's answers to questions 13 to 27 (Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, Google Doc https://docs.google.com/document/d/1pkAPGqWVTdtYorNN4SVNl9HkHxuuB9czro_y2DbUeEM/edit, saved word for word in full-pass-2026-10-27/ANSWERS-13-27-2026-10-27.md), read 28 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, answer 20: “Yes, the board 7.2 note is out of date. Follow the page: the detail page has no Delete. Delete is in the "Edit Library Part" window (S11-R3).”
